    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length9_55/training_13.csv",
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length9_55/training_14.csv"
]

# Read all source tables into a list of DataFrames
dfs = []
for file_path in source_files:
    # Read CSV with index_col=0 to ignore the numerical index column
    df = pd.read_csv(file_path, index_col=0)
    # Ensure the column 'revol_util' is integer type as per target schema
    df['revol_util'] = df['revol_util'].astype(int)
    dfs.append(df)

# Since all source tables have the exact same schema ['revol_util'] as the target,
# we can simply concatenate (union) all source tables vertically.
target_df = pd.concat(dfs, ignore_index=True)

# Final target schema is ['revol_util'] with integer type, already ensured.

# Write the combined DataFrame to the target CSV file path
target_df.to_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length9_55/target_multisource_cot.csv", index=False)
